system.description:
Also when you select this archetype at 1st level, the alien spores flowing through your veins attack the minds of your targets. The damage dealt by your Sanguine Transference is psychic damage.

Additionally, choose one of the following:

Like a Bird in a Nest

You can innately cast the sleep spell as an action without the need of spell components. For determining hit points worth of creatures affected, the spell is treated as if using a spell slot equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this ability a number of times between long rests equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up).

Join Us

When an enemy creature hits you with an attack, you can immediately use your reaction to give it a taste of the hive mind. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your maneuver DC or take 1d8 + your bloodblade level points of psychic damage. This ability can be used a number of times per short or long rest equal to your Intelligence modifier.

options.name: Like a Bird in a Nest
